rationale: No supported optimization is both applicable and not already present. The workflow already applies dependency/environment caching via matlab-actions/setup-matlab@v3 with cache: true (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-ENV-CACHE), and the job already has an explicit custom timeout budget (timeout-minutes: 180, with tighter step timeouts of 5 and 15 minutes) consistent with P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix (single job). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is unsafe here: required_checks are unverified (empty/not_verified), and canceling in-progress runs of a reusable workflow used as a check could affect required-status semantics; branch-protection review is required but not established. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER and P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW do not fit a workflow_call reusable workflow whose triggers are controlled by the caller. P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-PRIORITIZE/SELECT lack representative history (ci_history shows no completed runs). No Bazel or npm install step exists for the Bazel/dependency-cache patterns. Applying any further change would either duplicate an existing control or weaken required-check coverage without verified evidence.
